properties.name: After setup, a project never has to change again for reflow2 to move
properties.statement: Installing reflow2 into a project should put a paragraph in the agent instructions and a server address in the MCP config, and nothing else that ever needs refreshing. Upgrades belong to the reflow2 package: today `reflow2_init.py` copies fifteen skills into two directory trees plus AGENTS.md, so upgrading means re-running init and taking thirty-odd changed files into a repo that has nothing to do with reflow2's release. Anthony's brother, 2026-07-25: "you wouldn't need to change anything in your repo again and updates would be confined to the reflow package." The installer's own docstring already concedes the defect — "the kit is copied into your project, so it otherwise freezes at install time while reflow2 keeps moving" — and reflow2's own kit manifest sat four releases stale without anything noticing (ver:kit-manifest-agrees).
